_note: capability-rows-say-the-whole-capability 1.20 (REQ-CRS-39, row 11.23): you group templates in folders. A template names the category it belongs to, and the Templates page groups on the distinct categories (folderSidebar source field, which reads the facet over the whole query, so `facetable` is the whole contract). Free text rather than an enum: the categories are the municipality's own, the same way a case type's category is. Empty leaves a template under All templates only. A change to `properties` alone, which the importer compares, so the version stays.

category.title: Category
category.description: The folder this template sits in on the Templates page, for example Permits or Enforcement. Empty: the template is listed under All templates only.
